name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's fascination with motorsport began in his youth, watching Formula One races on television. He was particularly captivated by the engineering marvels that allowed these machines to push the boundaries of speed and performance. This passion led him to pursue a degree in materials science, focusing on composite materials. After graduating, he spent several years working in the aerospace industry, honing his skills in carbon fiber layup and structural analysis. 

Eventually, Kenji realized his dream of working in motorsport and joined Mitsubishi Motorsport. His meticulous approach to composite repair and fabrication, combined with his deep understanding of material properties, has made him an invaluable asset to the team. He is known for his insistence on precision and his unwavering commitment to ensuring the highest quality standards in every component he works on. He is a key figure in ensuring the cars are reliable and perform to their maximum potential. He believes deeply in continuous improvement through rigorous testing and analysis.
